title: a draft is checked again at save time against the current allowlists, its id must be its file name, and its status must be written so the save can change it; nothing is saved
source: intended: docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut" (build save asks on a terminal or takes --yes): a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK, which is a terminal answer or --yes; the guard denies the agent
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). The allowlists may have changed since the draft was written, so `build save` re-checks the draft with the rules of `build draft`: `JITSO REJECTED: draft "<id>" is invalid: <problems joined by "; ">`, exit 2, nothing shown as saved. A draft whose `id` is not its file name is invalid (`the id "<x>" must be the file name "<id>"`), because the saved file would then carry another name than its id. A status written with a tag (`!!str draft`) is a valid draft that cannot be saved byte for byte: `JITSO REJECTED: draft "<id>" cannot be saved: write its status as the plain word draft, or in quotes`.
